nodes.label: PostalCodeNotServedError (-> 404)
nodes.rationale: Two exception types map cleanly to 404 vs 502 without inspecting a reason field.

nodes.label: docker-compose.yml (api + redis:7-alpine)
nodes.rationale: environment: REDIS_URL overrides env_file .env so one .env serves local and Docker; redis pinned to major 7 for reproducibility.

nodes.label: Multi-stage Dockerfile (python:3.11-slim, non-root appuser)
nodes.rationale: Builder + runtime stages minimise image size and attack surface; non-root user enforced in-container rather than trusting the orchestrator.

nodes.label: GET /health liveness endpoint
nodes.rationale: Unauthenticated probe that touches neither Redis nor Mercadona so Docker HEALTHCHECK/orchestrators can detect dead instances; kept outside /api/v1 so verify_api_key does not apply by construction.

nodes.label: Settings (pydantic-settings env configuration)
nodes.rationale: Reused unchanged: all config injected via env vars/.env; missing MERCADONA_BASE_URL/REDIS_URL fails fast with ValidationError.

nodes.label: AppState dataclass + typing.cast
nodes.rationale: Typed view over app.state so attribute typos are caught statically; cast() has zero runtime cost and avoids the newer lifespan-state pattern.

nodes.label: app/core/dependencies.py shared providers
nodes.rationale: Centralises get_settings/get_cache_repository/get_mercadona_client to remove duplicated get_settings/_get_settings; products.py re-exports to keep tests untouched.

nodes.label: _search_algolia private method
nodes.rationale: Extracted so search() can call Algolia twice (cached then fresh credentials) without recursion risk.

nodes.label: In-memory Algolia credentials cache with reactive invalidation
nodes.norm_label: in-memory algolia credentials cache with reactive invalidation
nodes.rationale: Avoids re-fetching asset-manifest + legacy JS bundle on every Redis cache miss (anti-ban); invalidate and retry once on Algolia 401/403 instead of an arbitrary TTL.

nodes.label: ProductQuery postal_code 5-digit pattern
nodes.rationale: Declarative Field(pattern) in ProductQuery publishes to OpenAPI and keeps validation in the model, not scattered checks.

nodes.label: Cache key search:{warehouse}:{term}
nodes.rationale: Postal codes sharing a warehouse share cache; different warehouses never mix; old keys expire by TTL.

nodes.label: WarehouseCacheRepository (positive + negative keys via MGET)
nodes.rationale: Separate prefix postal-code-wh-unserved: instead of a sentinel because warehouse ids are opaque; single MGET avoids double Redis latency; absorbs RedisError like CacheRepository.

nodes.label: Negative cache for unserved postal codes (WAREHOUSE_NEGATIVE_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS=3600)
nodes.norm_label: negative cache for unserved postal codes (warehouse_negative_cache_ttl_seconds=3600)
nodes.rationale: Repeated 404 postal codes are not re-queried within 1h; short TTL tolerates new store openings.

nodes.label: postal_code -> warehouse resolution via change-pc (x-customer-wh)
nodes.rationale: Mercadona prices/catalogue differ per warehouse; previously everything used hardcoded mad1, so results were wrong and mis-cached per postal code.

nodes.label: PageOutOfRangeError (-> 404 Page out of range)
nodes.rationale: Algolia returns nbHits 0 for out-of-range pages; 404 avoids a false total and an extra upstream call.

nodes.label: RawAlgoliaSearchResult (hits, nbHits, nbPages required)
nodes.rationale: Required nbHits/nbPages so a missing total fails visibly instead of producing a fake total.

nodes.label: Search term normalization in ProductQuery (mode=before validator)
nodes.norm_label: search term normalization in productquery (mode=before validator)
nodes.rationale: Algolia is affected by leading/trailing spaces but not case/inner spaces, so normalising never worsens results and dedupes cache keys; done before min/max length so whitespace-only terms are rejected.

nodes.label: Pagination (page, page_size) with real total_results/total_pages
nodes.rationale: Previously total_results was len(products) capped at 50, silently hiding results; nbHits/nbPages now exposed; 1-based public page.

nodes.label: Coverage fail_under=80 in pyproject.toml
nodes.rationale: Single source for the threshold shared by local and CI.

nodes.label: Dockerfile builder uses uv export from lockfile
nodes.norm_label: dockerfile builder uses uv export from lockfile
nodes.rationale: Ensures the image ships exactly the versions CI tested; avoids a committed requirements.txt that could drift.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions CI workflow (ci.yml, Python 3.11)
nodes.rationale: Tests the exact Python version and dependency versions deployed in Docker; motivated by red intermediate commit bd537a8 and untested 3.11.

nodes.label: uv.lock lockfile managed with uv
nodes.rationale: Single multiplatform lock for prod+dev, --locked fails CI when out of sync; chosen over pip-tools and Poetry.

nodes.label: HTTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS passed to build_mercadona_http_client
nodes.rationale: Makes the implicit httpx 5s timeout explicit and configurable; factory takes a float, not Settings, to avoid coupling.

nodes.label: Hung Redis test fixture (asyncio.start_server never responds)
nodes.norm_label: hung redis test fixture (asyncio.start_server never responds)
nodes.rationale: Uses the real redis-py client to prove Redis.from_url receives the timeouts, which an AsyncMock could not.

nodes.label: GET /ready readiness endpoint (CacheRepository.ping)
nodes.rationale: Separates readiness (Redis reachable) from liveness (/health) so a Redis outage does not restart healthy processes; does not check Mercadona to avoid all instances going unready due to a third party.

nodes.label: REDIS_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (socket and connect timeout, default 1s)
nodes.rationale: Redis client had no timeout so a hung Redis hung requests; existing RedisError degradation only works if Redis fails fast; 1s bounds added latency to about 4s.

nodes.label: AlgoliaResponseInvalid exception (-> UpstreamUnavailableError -> 502)
nodes.rationale: Keeps Pydantic ValidationError out of the service layer; broken upstream data is a provider fault (502), not internal (500).

nodes.label: Raw Algolia models reduced to the seven consumed fields
nodes.norm_label: raw algolia models reduced to the seven consumed fields
nodes.rationale: Unused fields (popularity_score, objectID, badges.is_water, selling_method) changing upstream caused 500s for every search; declaring only consumed fields tolerates irrelevant schema drift.

nodes.label: RawAlgoliaResponse.model_validate_json full-body validation
nodes.rationale: One validation step covers non-JSON, missing/empty results and missing hits/nbHits/nbPages instead of catching KeyError/IndexError/JSON errors.

nodes.label: WARNING log with field loc and error type only (max 5)
nodes.norm_label: warning log with field loc and error type only (max 5)
nodes.rationale: Never logs str(exc), msg or input which contain Mercadona data.

nodes.label: HEALTHCHECK via python/httpx instead of curl
nodes.norm_label: healthcheck via python/httpx instead of curl
nodes.rationale: httpx is already a production dependency; installing curl only for the healthcheck would inflate the image.

nodes.label: unit_price typed as float in raw model
nodes.norm_label: unit_price typed as float in raw model
nodes.rationale: All failures of used fields surface from validation in one place; mapper no longer calls float(); Decimal rejected since two decimals fit float.

nodes.label: CI Workflow (lint, format, tests via uv)
nodes.norm_label: ci workflow (lint, format, tests via uv)

nodes.label: Algolia search via legacy bundle credentials (D7)
nodes.norm_label: algolia search via legacy bundle credentials (d7)

nodes.label: USER_AGENTS pool (one UA per client instance)
nodes.norm_label: user_agents pool (one ua per client instance)

nodes.label: X-API-Key header auth with API_KEYS env
nodes.norm_label: x-api-key header auth with api_keys env

nodes.label: Internal JSON endpoints only, no browser scraping (#2)
nodes.norm_label: internal json endpoints only, no browser scraping (#2)
